integrity.review_scope: Same-model scientific review only; no independent audit or validation.
integrity.sources: Source theorem and face characterization are attributed to Knudson and Owens–White; signed-reversal calculation is distinguished as the finding.
integrity.verification: Finite tests corroborate the infinite recurrence but are not a proof by exhaustive enumeration.

scientific_limitations: The result classifies the rational action of the path-reversing involution on the full strong Morse matching complex, not the pure or ordinary Morse complex.
No canonical equivariant sphere model, integral equivariant extension, or wider graph-action classification is asserted.
An equivalent independently derived but unindexed calculation cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Path reversal has a mod-eight orientation character on strong Morse matching complexes
